value.rationale: Arithmetic descent of unordered periodic cycles is an intrinsic, naturally complete invariant of the Hessian algebraic moduli self-map. It distinguishes geometric orbit number from rational orbit existence, revealing two quadratic cyclotomic components and a nonabelian dihedral quartic component. It is not an arbitrarily selected finite field case or a restatement of B3=8.
